reuse.why: Replaces the three copied category queries with one getBudgetableCategories helper and reuses extractTagsFromText and getSheetValue, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline exclusion rule instead of using the helper.

duplication.why: The '#fixed group or income outside tracking' guard is pasted into five loops, and the hidden/template exclusion is written twice (SQL in the helper, TS predicate in copyPreviousMonth), with the notes/group join also duplicated in getBudgetData.

placement.why: All logic stays in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in app.ts next to its siblings, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the budget actions, their handler registration and tests for the requested behaviours.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rule is split between a SQL helper, five copied in-loop guards and a separate TS predicate in copyPreviousMonth, which also silently ignores includeHiddenCategories, so the next rule change must be applied in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in actions.ts re-implements hidden/group-hidden/template/#fixed exclusion inline over getBudgetData instead of using getBudgetableCategories, and does not accept includeHiddenCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The template exclusion appears as SQL 'goal_def IS NULL OR goal_def = '[]'' in getBudgetableCategories and as a reshaped TS condition in copyPreviousMonth; the hidden rule likewise as SQL vs TS.

abstraction_drift.where: getBudgetableCategories gains includeHiddenCategories with an inline '? OR' SQL branch; the #fixed rule never enters it, so setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg each re-check it, and copyPreviousMonth bypasses the helper entirely.
